Shield Trigger
Powered Breaker
■ This creature gets +1000 power for each card in your graveyard.
■ When you put this creature, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your graveyard. Then choose one of your opponent's creatures that costs less than the number of cards in your graveyard and destroy it.
